pages.title: Starlight Star
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r Crafted at a crafting table with 4 Glowstone, 4 Amethyst Shards and 1 Diamond.$(br2)§lEffect: §r$(br)Active while held or embedded in armor: +20% movement speed at night; night vision at night; mob experience drops are doubled. Effects only apply at night (ticks 13000~23000); they never apply during the day, in the Nether or in the End.
The grid above shows the layout: glowstone in the corners, amethyst shards on the edges, diamond in the center.
